snippet.text: remainders o base m h W := fun n p => ![barMoment 0 (actualRadialError o base m h W) n p, barMoment 2 (thetaQuadratic m h) n p, barMoment 1 (axialQuadratic m h) n p - (1/2) * barMoment 2 (actualRadialError o base m h W) n p], with thetaQuadratic m h = m.axial*h.angular + h.axial*m.angular + h.axial*h.angular and axialQuadratic m h = 2•(m.axial*h.axial) + h.axial*h.axial
